parameters.query:
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM executions WHERE id = $1::uuid) AS found,
       (
         SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'id', e.id::text,
           'type', e.flow_type,
           'status', e.status,
           'timestamp', to_char(e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS') || '-03:00',
           'duration_ms', e.duration_ms,
           'cache_hit', e.cache_hit,
           'source_execution_id', e.source_execution_id::text,
           'telemetry', CASE WHEN t.execution_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
             'provider', t.provider,
             'model_requested', t.model_requested,
             'model_used', t.model_used,
             'openrouter_generation_id', NULL,
             'prompt_tokens', t.prompt_tokens,
             'completion_tokens', t.completion_tokens,
             'total_tokens', t.total_tokens,
             'cost_total_usd', t.cost_usd::float8,
             'cost_input_usd', t.input_cost_usd::float8,
             'cost_output_usd', t.output_cost_usd::float8,
             'cache_read_tokens', t.cache_read_tokens
           ) END,
           'input_payload', e.input_payload,
           'output_payload', e.output_payload,
           'error_message', e.error_message,
           'steps', COALESCE((
             SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'id', s.id::text,
               'timestamp', to_char(s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS') || '-03:00',
               'node_name', s.node_name,
               'kind', s.kind,
               'status', s.status,
               'duration_ms', s.duration_ms,
               'input_payload', s.input_payload,
               'output_payload', s.output_payload,
               'error_message', s.error_message
             ) ORDER BY s.created_at ASC)
             FROM execution_steps s
             WHERE s.execution_id = e.id
           ), '[]'::jsonb)
         )
         FROM executions e
         LEFT JOIN execution_telemetry t ON t.execution_id = e.id
         WHERE e.id = $1::uuid
       ) AS response;

parameters.jsCode:
const found = $json.found === true;
return [{ json: { found, response: found ? $json.response : { error: 'not_found', message: 'Execucao nao encontrada.' } } }];
